Logic:

- schema = findSchemaResourceRoot()
- node = schema.getSchemaNode()
- jsonPointer = ref
- if (schema.getId()!=null && ref.startsWith(schema.getId())) { jsonPointer = ref.substring(schema.getId().length()); }
- if (jsonPointer.startsWith("#/")) { jsonPointer = jsonPointer.substring(1); }
- if (jsonPointer.startsWith("/")) { try decode; node = node.at(jsonPointer); if node.isMissingNode() { node = handleNullNode(ref, schema); } }
- return node

1. schema.getId() null or not null and ref starts with id => branch true/false.
2. jsonPointer starts with "#/" => true/false.
3. jsonPointer starts with "/" => true/false.

   node.at(jsonPointer) returns missing node => triggers handleNullNode branch; else not missing.
